preconditions: a2 points to a MAS filename string (CHAR *) passed through to the loader sub_53CBC0 without interpretation.
a1 may be null; when non-null it must point to a writable pointer slot that sub_53CBC0 populates with the loaded object.
The loader sub_53CBC0 (contract content_bootstrap_r2_mas_root.packet_000.v1, cut edge) must be available; it performs the actual MAS file load and allocation.
Return value 0 from sub_53CBC0 is treated as loader success; any non-zero value short-circuits the flag write.
postconditions: Returns the result of sub_53CBC0 unchanged in all paths.
When the loader returns 0 and a1 is non-null, the flags dword at mas_object+0x114 gains bit 3 (value 0x8), marking the loaded object for post-setup pruning / error-handling state.
When the loader returns non-zero, mas_object+0x114 is never written by this function.
When a1 is null, no dereference or flag write occurs; the loader result is still returned.

Conditionally ORs 0x8 into the dword at mas_object+0x114 when the load succeeds and a1 is non-null.
The single 0x8 bit write is a read-modify-write of a 4-byte flags word; no other bits of that word are altered.
